items.reason_zh: Ansible authorized_key 模块中错误地使用 os.chown() 而非 os.lchown()，使得非特权用户能够操纵符号链接并通过 SSH 密钥提权。

items.reason_en: Reliance on stat() for VT ownership testing follows symlinks, allowing local attackers to pre-stage symbolic links and bypass authentication checks for privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: 依赖 stat() 进行 VT 所有权测试时会跟随符号链接，允许本地攻击者预置符号链接并绕过身份验证检查以实现提权。

items.reason_en: Symlink traversal in getfattr and setfattr utilities allows local attackers to replace directory components and escalate privileges during file attribute operations.
items.reason_zh: getfattr 和 setfattr 工具中的符号链接遍历漏洞允许本地攻击者在文件属性操作期间替换目录组件并提权。

items.reason_en: Arbitrary code execution occurs when Vim executes reconstructed Python definitions via exec() during omni-completion. This poses a severe risk to developers relying on Vim's Python integration.
items.reason_zh: 当 Vim 在 omni-completion 期间通过 exec() 执行重构的 Python 定义时，会发生任意代码执行。这对依赖 Vim Python 集成的开发者构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Local attackers can escalate privileges by exploiting symlink traversal in libacl pathname functions. This undermines filesystem access control mechanisms on Unix-like systems.
items.reason_zh: 本地攻击者可通过利用 libacl 路径名函数中的符号链接遍历漏洞来提权。这破坏了类 Unix 系统上的文件系统访问控制机制。

items.reason_en: The Linux kernel network fragment handling fails to propagate shared-frag markers, potentially causing packet corruption or denial of service in network-heavy desktop and server environments.
items.reason_zh: Linux kernel 的网络分片处理未能正确传播共享分片标记，可能在网络密集的桌面和服务器环境中导致数据包损坏或拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Dracut improperly quotes shell variables derived from DHCP options, allowing adjacent network attackers to inject arbitrary commands into the initramfs emergency environment during boot.
items.reason_zh: Dracut 错误地对源自 DHCP 选项的 shell 变量进行引号包裹，允许相邻网络攻击者在启动时将任意命令注入 initramfs 紧急环境。

items.reason_en: CUPS image filters lack error recovery handlers for malformed PNG files, enabling unauthenticated attackers to crash the printing subsystem and cause a local denial of service.
items.reason_zh: CUPS 图像过滤器缺乏针对格式错误 PNG 文件的错误恢复处理程序，使得未认证的攻击者能够崩溃打印子系统并引发本地拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: External file path control flaw in Microsoft Edge for Android allows local information disclosure, potentially exposing sensitive mobile user data.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Microsoft Edge 中的外部文件路径控制缺陷允许本地信息泄露，可能暴露敏感的移动用户数据。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in Microsoft 365 Copilot for iOS enables unauthorized privilege elevation over the network, risking compromised mobile productivity accounts.
items.reason_zh: iOS 版 Microsoft 365 Copilot 中的不当访问控制漏洞允许通过网络进行未授权的权限提升，危及移动生产力账户的安全。

items.reason_en: ToCToU race condition in Microsoft Edge for Android allows remote code execution, highlighting critical runtime safety gaps in mobile browsers.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Microsoft Edge 中的 ToCToU 竞态条件漏洞允许远程代码执行，凸显了移动浏览器在运行时安全方面的关键缺陷。

items.reason_en: Improper UI layer restriction in the Bing App for iOS enables network-based spoofing; compromises mobile application integrity and user trust.
items.reason_zh: iOS版Bing App存在UI层限制不当漏洞，可导致基于网络的欺骗攻击；破坏移动应用完整性及用户信任。

items.reason_en: Path traversal flaw in Microsoft Teams for Android permits unauthorized remote code execution, compromising mobile collaboration platforms and end-user devices.
items.reason_zh: Android版Microsoft Teams存在路径遍历缺陷，允许未授权的远程代码执行，危及移动协作平台及终端用户设备。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 MS Teams for Android injection vulnerability allows network-based information disclosure, exposing sensitive mobile communication metadata.
items.reason_zh: Android版MS Teams存在CVSS评分为8.1的注入漏洞，可导致基于网络的信息泄露，暴露敏感的移动通信元数据。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.1 Office for Android improper access control facilitates local spoofing attacks, undermining trust in mobile document rendering and handling.
items.reason_zh: Android版Office存在CVSS评分为7.1的不当访问控制漏洞，助长本地欺骗攻击，削弱用户对移动端文档渲染与处理的信任。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution vulnerability in Zscaler Client Connector across Android, iOS, and ChromeOS allows unauthenticated attackers to gain full control over mobile endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Zscaler Client Connector在Android、iOS和ChromeOS上存在远程代码执行漏洞，允许未认证攻击者完全控制移动终端。

items.reason_en: Locally exploitable buffer overflow in Zscaler Client Connector for Android and ChromeOS can trigger denial-of-service conditions on mobile devices.
items.reason_zh: Zscaler Client Connector在Android和ChromeOS上存在可在本地利用的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可触发移动设备的拒绝服务状态。

items.reason_en: Missing validation of the virtio descriptor-chain head ID in the Zephyr RTOS allows out-of-bounds array indexing, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution in embedded devices.
items.reason_zh: Zephyr RTOS中缺失对virtio描述符链头ID的验证，可导致数组越界索引，潜在引发嵌入式设备的任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Lack of proper protection against voltage and clock glitches in the Microchip SAMA5D4 MCU enables hardware fault injection attacks that can bypass security controls.
items.reason_zh: Microchip SAMA5D4 MCU缺乏针对电压与时钟毛刺的有效防护，易受硬件故障注入攻击，从而绕过安全控制机制。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded FTP credentials combined with unrestricted file uploads allow attackers to fully compromise DJI drone firmware and persist malicious payloads.
items.reason_zh: 硬编码的FTP凭据结合无限制的文件上传功能，使攻击者能够完全入侵DJI无人机固件并持久化恶意载荷。

items.reason_en: An unauthenticated HTTP media server exposes stored drone footage via predictable filenames, enabling mass data exfiltration without network authentication.
items.reason_zh: 未认证的HTTP媒体服务器通过可预测的文件名暴露存储的无人机影像，使得无需网络认证即可实现大规模数据外泄。

items.reason_en: Shared RSA-512 mesh group keys across TP-Link Deco firmware weaken node authentication, allowing attackers to intercept or manipulate mesh network traffic.
items.reason_zh: TP-Link Deco固件中跨节点共享RSA-512 Mesh组密钥削弱了节点认证，允许攻击者拦截或篡改网状网络流量。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Netis NC63 router firmware allows unauthenticated attackers to overwrite stack memory via crafted CGI requests, enabling full device takeover.
items.reason_zh: Netis NC63路由器固件存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许未认证攻击者通过构造的CGI请求覆盖栈内存，从而实现设备完全接管。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Comfast CF-N1-S router web management interface allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via manipulated NTP parameters.
items.reason_zh: Comfast CF-N1-S路由器Web管理界面存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许远程攻击者通过篡改NTP参数执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated stack buffer overflow in UTT HiPER 1250GW HTTP handler enables remote code execution through crafted profile configuration requests.
items.reason_zh: UTT HiPER 1250GW HTTP处理器存在未认证的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞，可通过构造的配置档案请求实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Exposes an unauthenticated Bluetooth interface that allows attackers within range to modify Wi-Fi configurations and credentials on consumer drones, risking device hijacking.
items.reason_zh: 暴露了未认证的蓝牙接口，使范围内的攻击者能够修改消费级无人机的Wi-Fi配置与凭据，存在设备被劫持的风险。

items.reason_en: Contains an unauthenticated OS command injection via an exposed ADOdb test page, enabling remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands on security hardware management systems.
items.reason_zh: 通过暴露的ADOdb测试页面存在未认证的操作系统命令注入漏洞，使远程攻击者能够在安全硬件管理系统上执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Allows eval injection through crafted CSV data in radio driver scripts, potentially compromising field communication devices programmed via the CHIRP software.
items.reason_zh: 通过在无线电驱动脚本中使用构造的CSV数据允许eval注入，可能危及通过CHIRP软件编程的野外通信设备。

items.reason_en: DJI drones transmit sensitive control protocols over unencrypted Bluetooth Low Energy, allowing nearby attackers to intercept or manipulate flight data and device configurations.
items.reason_zh: DJI无人机通过未加密的蓝牙低功耗（BLE）传输敏感控制协议，使附近攻击者能够拦截或篡改飞行数据及设备配置。

items.reason_en: The eNet SMART HOME server lacks proper authorization checks in its JSON-RPC interface, enabling low-privileged users to escalate privileges and fully compromise the smart home infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: eNet SMART HOME服务器的JSON-RPC接口缺乏适当的授权检查，使低权限用户能够提升权限并完全入侵智能家居基础设施。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in Azure Cosmos DB allows unauthorized network-based code execution, directly threatening managed NoSQL database tenants.
items.reason_zh: Azure Cosmos DB存在不当的访问控制漏洞，允许未授权的网络代码执行，直接威胁托管的NoSQL数据库租户。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure Key Vault enables privilege elevation over the network, creating severe risks for cryptographic key management and secrets storage.
items.reason_zh: Azure Key Vault缺失身份验证机制，允许通过网络进行权限提升，对密码学密钥管理及机密存储造成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in Microsoft Exchange Online allows network-based tampering, jeopardizing enterprise communication infrastructure and data integrity.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Online存在不当的身份验证机制，允许基于网络的篡改行为，危及企业通信基础设施与数据完整性。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in M365 Copilot enables remote code execution, exposing AI-integrated SaaS platforms to full system compromise.
items.reason_zh: M365 Copilot中存在不受信任数据的反序列化漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，使集成AI的SaaS平台面临系统完全被控的风险。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in the Windows Container Isolation FS Filter Driver allows local information disclosure, raising concerns about container breakout risks.
items.reason_zh: Windows Container Isolation FS Filter Driver存在越界读取漏洞，可导致本地信息泄露，引发对容器逃逸风险的担忧。

items.reason_en: Uncaught exception in Windows Server Update Service enables network-based tampering, threatening patch management integrity in hybrid cloud deployments.
items.reason_zh: Windows Server Update Service中存在未捕获异常漏洞，可导致基于网络的篡改，威胁混合云部署中的补丁管理完整性。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Azure Active Directory triggers denial of service; threatens identity federation and authentication availability.
items.reason_zh: Azure Active Directory中存在不受信任数据的反序列化漏洞，可触发拒绝服务；威胁身份联合与身份验证服务的可用性。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure CycleCloud allows privilege escalation over networks; exposes cloud workload orchestration to unauthorized administrative control.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud缺失身份验证机制，允许通过网络进行权限提升；使云工作负载编排暴露于未授权的管理控制之下。

items.reason_en: Insufficient access control in Active Directory Federation Services enables local privilege escalation; flagged as actively exploited in the wild, requiring urgent remediation.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Federation Services存在访问控制不足漏洞，可导致本地权限提升；该漏洞已被标记为在实际环境中遭活跃利用，需紧急修复。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure Kubernetes Service allows unauthenticated attackers to escalate privileges and take full control of managed clusters.
items.reason_zh: Azure Kubernetes Service缺失身份验证机制，允许未认证攻击者提升权限并完全控制托管集群。

items.reason_en: Improper authorization in Azure Red Hat OpenShift enables remote privilege escalation, exposing containerized workloads to unauthorized access.
items.reason_zh: Azure Red Hat OpenShift存在不当的授权机制，可导致远程权限提升，使容器化工作负载暴露于未授权访问之下。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Azure OpenAI allows attackers to pivot to internal services and escalate privileges within the cloud environment.
items.reason_zh: Azure OpenAI 中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞使攻击者能够转向内部服务，并在云环境中实现权限提升。

items.reason_en: A critical flaw in Oracle Web Services Manager's security component allows low-privileged attackers to bypass authentication and compromise cloud middleware services.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Web Services Manager 安全组件中的关键缺陷允许低权限攻击者绕过身份验证并破坏云中间件服务。

items.reason_en: Easily exploitable vulnerabilities in Oracle Identity Manager's legacy UI enable remote code execution via RMI, facilitating lateral movement in enterprise identity infrastructures.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Identity Manager 遗留用户界面中易于利用的漏洞可通过 RMI 实现远程代码执行，从而在企业身份基础设施中进行横向移动。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated LDAP exploitation in Oracle Internet Directory grants attackers full directory access, compromising centralized authentication for cloud and on-premise systems.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Internet Directory 中的未认证 LDAP 利用漏洞可使攻击者获得完整的目录访问权限，从而破坏云端和本地系统的集中式身份验证。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Entra ID permits unauthenticated remote code execution, directly compromising foundational identity and access management services.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra ID 中的不信任数据反序列化漏洞允许未认证远程代码执行，直接破坏基础身份与访问管理服务。

items.reason_en: Argument injection in Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra allows unauthenticated remote code execution, threatening the integrity of managed NoSQL database workloads.
items.reason_zh: Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra 中的参数注入漏洞允许未认证远程代码执行，威胁托管 NoSQL 数据库工作负载的完整性。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization checks in the Azure SRE Agent enable unauthorized remote privilege escalation, jeopardizing cloud operational workflows and infrastructure control.
items.reason_zh: Azure SRE Agent 中缺失的授权检查可导致未授权远程权限提升，危及云运维工作流和基础设施控制权。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass via capture-replay in Exchange Server enables remote privilege escalation, severely compromising enterprise email infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中通过抓包重放绕过身份验证的漏洞可实现远程权限提升，严重破坏企业电子邮件基础设施。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Azure CycleCloud allows remote attackers to escalate privileges and gain unauthorized control over cloud compute clusters.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 中缺失的授权机制允许远程攻击者提权并获得对云计算集群的未授权控制。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Azure Storage Explorer enables remote attackers to elevate privileges and potentially hijack user sessions or exfiltrate sensitive storage data.
items.reason_zh: Azure Storage Explorer 中的跨站脚本漏洞使远程攻击者能够提升权限，并可能劫持用户会话或窃取敏感存储数据。

items.reason_en: SharePoint deserialization of untrusted data allows network-based remote code execution, directly endangering cloud-hosted collaboration and document management platforms.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的不信任数据反序列化漏洞允许基于网络的远程代码执行，直接危及云托管协作与文档管理平台。

items.reason_en: Improper input validation in Power BI enables remote code execution over the network, exposing business intelligence deployments to direct compromise.
items.reason_zh: Power BI 中输入验证不当导致网络远程代码执行，使商业智能部署面临直接被破坏的风险。

items.reason_en: Active Directory Certificate Services use-after-free vulnerability permits network-based remote code execution, jeopardizing the entire PKI and authentication chain.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Certificate Services 中的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞允许基于网络的远程代码执行，危及整个 PKI 和身份验证链。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the Container Isolation FS Filter driver allows local privilege escalation, weakening security boundaries for containerized workloads.
items.reason_zh: Container Isolation FS Filter 驱动程序中的堆溢出漏洞允许本地权限提升，削弱了容器化工作负载的安全边界。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass by spoofing in Azure HorizonDB grants unauthorized privilege escalation over the network, critically undermining Azure infrastructure identity controls.
items.reason_zh: Azure HorizonDB 中通过欺骗绕过身份验证的漏洞可在网络上实现未授权权限提升，严重破坏 Azure 基础设施的身份控制。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization of untrusted data in Azure Service Bus enables unauthenticated remote code execution, threatening cloud-native messaging and integration pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Azure Service Bus 中不信任数据的不安全反序列化漏洞允许未认证远程代码执行，威胁云原生消息传递与集成管道。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Azure Active Directory allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges, jeopardizing enterprise identity federation and access management.
items.reason_zh: Azure Active Directory 中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞允许具备权限的攻击者提权，危及企业身份联合与访问管理。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 Azure Stack Edge path traversal permits unauthenticated remote code execution, critically endangering edge computing infrastructure deployments.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 9.8 的 Azure Stack Edge 路径遍历漏洞允许未认证远程代码执行，严重危及边缘计算基础设施部署。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 Azure Kubernetes Service path traversal allows authenticated attackers to execute code locally, threatening container orchestration and cluster security.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8 的 Azure Kubernetes Service 路径遍历漏洞允许已认证攻击者在本地执行代码，威胁容器编排与集群安全。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.4 Azure Stack Edge cross-site scripting enables network spoofing attacks against cloud management interfaces, risking administrative session hijacking.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.4 的 Azure Stack Edge 跨站脚本漏洞可针对云管理接口实施网络欺骗攻击，存在管理员会话劫持风险。

items.reason_en: Critical improper authentication flaw in Azure Active Directory allows unauthenticated network-based privilege escalation, potentially compromising entire cloud tenant identities.
items.reason_zh: Azure Active Directory 中的关键身份验证不当缺陷允许未认证的基于网络的权限提升，可能导致整个云租户身份遭到破坏。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in Microsoft Dynamics 365 enables authorized users to escalate privileges over the network, risking unauthorized manipulation of business applications.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Dynamics 365 中的访问控制不当允许已授权用户通过网络提权，存在业务应用程序遭未授权篡改的风险。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication for critical functions in M365 Copilot allows unauthenticated information disclosure, exposing sensitive AI-generated content and user data.
items.reason_zh: M365 Copilot 关键功能缺失身份验证会导致未认证信息泄露，暴露敏感的 AI 生成内容与用户数据。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in LXD instance template processing allows container-editing users to overwrite host files as root, leading to full container escape and host compromise.
items.reason_zh: LXD 实例模板处理中的路径遍历漏洞允许容器编辑用户以 root 权限覆盖主机文件，导致容器完全逃逸及主机沦陷。

items.reason_en: A confused-deputy flaw permits unauthenticated SSRF and environment token exfiltration via crafted request headers, severely impacting cloud service account security.
items.reason_zh: 混淆副手漏洞允许通过构造的请求头进行未认证 SSRF 和环境令牌外泄，严重影响云服务账户安全。

items.reason_en: Chained exploitation via SQL Expressions and an Enterprise plugin enables remote code execution, posing critical risks to cloud-deployed observability platforms.
items.reason_zh: 通过 SQL 表达式与 Enterprise 插件的链式利用可实现远程代码执行，对云部署的可观测性平台构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Fails to strip X-SSL-Client-* headers on insecure edge routes, allowing unauthenticated attackers to spoof client certificates and bypass authentication mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: 在不安全边缘路由上未能剥离 X-SSL-Client-* 头，允许未认证攻击者伪造客户端证书并绕过身份验证机制。

items.reason_en: Unsanitized OAuth2 authentication headers allow forged tokens to bypass external middleware validation. This compromises identity management across OpenStack deployments.
items.reason_zh: 未经清理的 OAuth2 身份验证头允许伪造令牌绕过外部中间件验证，从而破坏 OpenStack 部署中的身份管理。

items.reason_en: Improper symlink validation in virt-handler permits authenticated users to redirect VM console sockets to sensitive host files. This breaks namespace isolation in containerized virtualization environments.
items.reason_zh: virt-handler 中符号链接验证不当允许已认证用户将虚拟机控制台套接字重定向至敏感主机文件，破坏容器化虚拟化环境中的命名空间隔离。

items.reason_en: Path traversal via the pathInRepo parameter in the git resolver enables tenants to access restricted repository contents. This threatens multi-tenant CI/CD pipeline security in Tekton.
items.reason_zh: git 解析器中通过 pathInRepo 参数的路径遍历漏洞使租户能够访问受限仓库内容，威胁 Tekton 中多租户 CI/CD 流水线的安全。

items.reason_en: Kata Containers accepts unvalidated configuration path annotations, allowing an attacker to achieve host-level code execution by escaping the lightweight VM boundary.
items.reason_zh: Kata Containers 接受未经验证的配置路径注解，允许攻击者通过逃逸轻量级虚拟机边界实现主机级代码执行。

items.reason_en: Red Hat Konnectivity proxy-server starts without cluster CA certificate validation, permitting remote attackers to impersonate legitimate cluster agents and gain unauthorized control plane access.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat Konnectivity proxy-server 在启动时未进行集群 CA 证书验证，允许远程攻击者冒充合法集群代理并获取未经授权的 Control Plane（控制平面）访问权限。

items.reason_en: STACKIT IaaS API suffers from a missing authorization check that allows low-privileged users to attach arbitrary service accounts to VMs, escalating to full organization compromise.
items.reason_zh: STACKIT IaaS API 存在缺失的授权检查漏洞，允许低权限用户将任意服务账户绑定至虚拟机，从而升级为对组织的全面接管。

items.reason_en: Open Cluster Management improperly validates Kubernetes client certificate renewals, enabling managed cluster administrators to forge certificates and bypass controller approval mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Open Cluster Management 未正确验证 Kubernetes 客户端证书的续期请求，使得受管集群管理员能够伪造证书并绕过控制器的审批机制。

items.reason_en: OpenShift Console Helm catalog proxy permits namespace tenants to plant malicious ProjectHelmChartRepository URLs, facilitating server-side request forgery and supply chain attacks against console pods.
items.reason_zh: OpenShift Console Helm catalog proxy 允许命名空间租户植入恶意的 ProjectHelmChartRepository URL，从而助长针对控制台 Pod 的服务端请求伪造及供应链攻击。

items.reason_en: Undisclosed DNS caching traffic triggers TMM termination in F5 BIG-IP devices, causing service disruption in critical load balancing and application delivery networks.
items.reason_zh: 未知 DNS 缓存流量会触发 F5 BIG-IP 设备中的 TMM 进程终止，导致关键负载均衡与应用交付网络服务中断。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8; Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows DHCP Server enables unauthorized network code execution, jeopardizing core IP address management and network availability.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 9.8；Windows DHCP Server 中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致未经授权的网络代码执行，严重威胁核心 IP 地址管理与网络可用性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1; Use-after-free in Windows DNS allows privilege escalation over a network, compromising essential name resolution infrastructure and enabling lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.1；Windows DNS 中存在释放后使用漏洞，允许攻击者通过网络提升权限，破坏关键名称解析基础设施并支持横向移动。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5; Out-of-bounds read in Windows Network Policy Server SNMP exposes sensitive information over a network, aiding attackers in reconnaissance and policy bypass.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 7.5；Windows Network Policy Server 的 SNMP 模块存在越界读取漏洞，可在网络中泄露敏感信息，辅助攻击者进行侦察与策略绕过。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows DHCP Server allows adjacent network attackers to execute code, directly compromising network infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许相邻网络攻击者执行代码，直接危及网络基础设施安全。

items.reason_en: Flawed authentication algorithm in SMB Server enables network-based privilege escalation, threatening file sharing and domain controller communications.
items.reason_zh: SMB Server 中存在缺陷的身份验证算法，可导致基于网络的权限提升，威胁文件共享与域控制器通信安全。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the Remote Desktop Client allows remote attackers to escalate privileges, jeopardizing secure desktop access protocols.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中存在堆溢出漏洞，允许远程攻击者提升权限，严重威胁安全的桌面访问协议。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in the WPAD protocol can be exploited to manipulate proxy auto-discovery configurations and intercept internal traffic.
items.reason_zh: WPAD 协议中存在整数溢出漏洞，可被利用以篡改代理自动发现配置并拦截内部流量。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows FTP Service allows remote code execution; critical for environments relying on legacy file transfer protocols.
items.reason_zh: Windows FTP Service 中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，对依赖传统文件传输协议的环境构成重大威胁。

items.reason_en: Race condition in the Windows TCP/IP stack enables remote code execution over adjacent networks; undermines foundational network protocol security.
items.reason_zh: Windows TCP/IP 协议栈中存在竞争条件漏洞，允许攻击者通过相邻网络执行远程代码，削弱了基础网络协议的安全性。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in DNS Server allows remote code execution; jeopardizes critical name resolution infrastructure essential for network routing.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中存在释放后使用漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，严重威胁对网络路由至关重要的关键名称解析基础设施。

items.reason_en: Command injection in DrayTek VigorAP models via unvalidated UDP messages allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary system commands and compromise network infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: DrayTek VigorAP 系列设备因未验证的 UDP 消息存在命令注入漏洞，允许远程攻击者执行任意系统命令并接管网络基础设施。

items.reason_en: Insufficient filtering of credentials in DrayTek VigorSwitch setDevProto function leads to remote command injection, enabling full device takeover.
items.reason_zh: DrayTek VigorSwitch 的 setDevProto 函数对凭据过滤不足，导致远程命令注入漏洞，可使攻击者完全接管设备。

items.reason_en: Stored command injection in TP-Link Archer routers allows adjacent attackers to inject shell metacharacters into profile names, executing arbitrary commands during report generation.
items.reason_zh: TP-Link Archer 路由器存在存储型命令注入漏洞，允许相邻攻击者在配置文件名称中注入 Shell 元字符，进而在生成报告时执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: A pre-authentication command injection in DrayTek VigorSwitch firmware allows immediate remote code execution by exploiting insufficient input filtering in the CGI interface.
items.reason_zh: DrayTek VigorSwitch 固件中存在预认证命令注入漏洞，攻击者可利用 CGI 接口输入过滤不严的问题直接实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: A stack-based buffer overflow in Netis router login handlers enables unauthenticated attackers to overwrite stack state and achieve complete firmware takeover.
items.reason_zh: Netis 路由器登录处理程序中存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许未授权攻击者覆盖栈内存并完全接管固件。

items.reason_en: A session validation bypass in EFM ipTIME routers grants unauthenticated users administrative control, allowing full network reconfiguration and persistence.
items.reason_zh: EFM ipTIME 路由器存在会话验证绕过漏洞，允许未认证用户获取管理员权限，从而实现网络全面重配与持久化驻留。

items.reason_en: A heap buffer overflow in GnuTLS DTLS handshake reassembly logic weakens cryptographic protocol implementations, potentially allowing remote attackers to crash services or execute code.
items.reason_zh: GnuTLS 的 DTLS 握手重组逻辑中存在堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，削弱了加密协议的安全性，可能导致远程攻击者使服务崩溃或执行代码。

items.reason_en: Malformed DTLS fragment parsing triggers an integer underflow and out-of-bounds read, creating reliable pathways for information disclosure and denial of service across networked devices.
items.reason_zh: 畸形的 DTLS 分片解析会触发整数下溢与越界读取漏洞，为跨网络设备的信息泄露与拒绝服务攻击提供了稳定利用途径。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows SMB server permits remote code execution over the network, critically endangering file sharing and Active Directory environments.
items.reason_zh: Windows SMB 服务器中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许攻击者通过网络执行远程代码，严重威胁文件共享与 Active Directory 环境安全。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows DHCP server allows remote code execution on adjacent networks, threatening fundamental network infrastructure stability.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP 服务器中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许攻击者在相邻网络执行远程代码，威胁基础网络基础设施的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in the Windows DNS service enables remote privilege escalation, jeopardizing critical name resolution and directory services.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 服务中存在释放后使用漏洞，可导致远程权限提升，严重威胁关键名称解析与目录服务安全。

items.reason_en: A critical stack-based buffer overflow in the Windows DNS server allows remote attackers to execute code over the network, threatening fundamental name resolution infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 服务器中存在严重的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许远程攻击者通过网络执行代码，威胁基础名称解析基础设施。

items.reason_en: The QUIC implementation use-after-free flaw enables remote code execution over the network, undermining secure transport layer protocols used by modern applications.
items.reason_zh: QUIC 协议实现中的释放后使用漏洞可导致远程代码执行，削弱了现代应用程序所依赖的安全传输层协议。

items.reason_en: TCP/IP stack buffer overflow allows unauthorized network code execution, potentially disrupting core networking operations and enabling lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: TCP/IP 协议栈存在缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致未经授权的网络代码执行，可能破坏核心网络功能并支持攻击者横向移动。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in the Routing and Remote Access Service grants attackers unauthorized machine access, severely compromising network routing and VPN infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Routing and Remote Access Service中的远程代码执行漏洞可使攻击者未经授权访问主机，严重破坏网络路由与VPN基础设施。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.1 Windows DHCP Server vulnerability allows network-wide packet tampering, disrupting critical IP address allocation and overall network connectivity.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 9.1 Windows DHCP Server漏洞允许进行全网范围的数据包篡改，破坏关键的IP地址分配及整体网络连接。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.6 Windows TCP/IP heap overflow enables adjacent network privilege escalation, exploiting foundational networking protocols used across enterprise routers and switches.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 9.6 Windows TCP/IP堆溢出漏洞可实现相邻网络权限提升，利用企业路由器与交换机广泛使用的基础网络协议进行攻击。

items.reason_en: LDAP injection vulnerability in WatchGuard Fireware OS allows unauthenticated remote attackers to bypass authentication or extract sensitive directory data via exposed management interfaces.
items.reason_zh: WatchGuard Fireware OS中的LDAP注入漏洞允许未认证的远程攻击者通过暴露的管理接口绕过身份验证或提取敏感目录数据。

items.reason_en: Remotely exploitable buffer overflow in Zscaler Client Connector triggers kernel-level denial-of-service attacks on Windows network gateways and endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Zscaler Client Connector中可远程利用的缓冲区溢出漏洞可在Windows网络网关和终端上触发内核级拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Known exploited RCE in SNMP notification processing allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on email collaboration servers, actively targeted in the wild.
items.reason_zh: SNMP通知处理过程中已知被利用的远程代码执行（RCE）漏洞允许未认证攻击者在邮件协作服务器上执行任意代码，该漏洞在实际环境中正遭积极利用。

items.reason_en: Mishandled EAP identity parsing triggers a double-free vulnerability, potentially causing crashes or memory corruption in VPN gateway implementations.
items.reason_zh: EAP身份解析处理不当会触发双重释放漏洞，可能导致VPN网关实现出现崩溃或内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Lenient routing logic improperly validates the HTTP/2 :path pseudo-header, resulting in authorization bypasses that grant unauthorized access to gRPC services.
items.reason_zh: 宽松的路由逻辑未能正确验证HTTP/2的:path伪头部，导致授权绕过并授予对gRPC服务的未授权访问。

items.reason_en: Misconfigured password scripts using %u pass unsanitized usernames, enabling authentication bypass and potential privilege escalation in Samba file servers and domain controllers.
items.reason_zh: 使用%u的配置错误密码脚本传递了未过滤的用户名，使得Samba文件服务器和域控制器面临认证绕过及潜在的权限提升风险。

items.reason_en: Flaws in the ngx_http_rewrite_module allow attackers to bypass security directives using crafted PCRE captures. This directly impacts traffic routing and filtering on F5 NGINX appliances.
items.reason_zh: ngx_http_rewrite_module中的缺陷允许攻击者利用构造的PCRE捕获组绕过安全指令。这直接影响F5 NGINX设备上的流量路由与过滤功能。

items.reason_en: In-place decryption on shared SKB fragments corrupts packet data due to improper fragment handling. This degrades network stack reliability in Linux-based routing and firewall systems.
items.reason_zh: 由于片段处理不当，对共享SKB片段进行就地解密会导致数据包数据损坏。这会降低基于Linux的路由与防火墙系统中网络栈的可靠性。

items.reason_en: Unescaped shell meta characters in the Samba print command enable remote code execution. Given Samba's ubiquity in enterprise file sharing, this presents a critical infrastructure risk.
items.reason_zh: Samba打印命令中存在未转义的Shell元字符，可导致远程代码执行。鉴于Samba在企业文件共享中的广泛应用，此漏洞构成关键基础设施风险。

items.reason_en: ipTIME T24000M routers fail to properly validate HTTP session tokens, allowing remote attackers to bypass authentication and gain full administrative control over the network device.
items.reason_zh: ipTIME T24000M路由器未能正确验证HTTP会话令牌，允许远程攻击者绕过身份验证并获取该网络设备的完全管理控制权。

items.reason_en: Samba’s SMB layer lacks access checks for NTFS-style reparse points on read-only shares, allowing authenticated users with filesystem permissions to corrupt share metadata and disrupt file services.
items.reason_zh: Samba的SMB层在只读共享上缺乏针对NTFS风格重解析点的访问检查，允许拥有文件系统权限的已认证用户破坏共享元数据并中断文件服务。

items.reason_en: Firmware modification vulnerability in Johnson Controls devices grants attackers full administrative access, risking physical operational technology environments.
items.reason_zh: Johnson Controls设备中的固件修改漏洞使攻击者获得完全管理访问权限，威胁物理运营技术（OT）环境的安全。

items.reason_en: Internal operations flaw in Oracle MES for Process Manufacturing allows low-privileged attackers to compromise manufacturing execution workflows via HTTP.
items.reason_zh: Oracle MES for Process Manufacturing的内部操作缺陷允许低权限攻击者通过HTTP破坏制造执行工作流。

items.reason_en: An integer overflow in open62541's OPC UA variant computation triggers out-of-bounds writes, destabilizing industrial communication protocols and control systems.
items.reason_zh: open62541的OPC UA变体计算中存在整数溢出漏洞，会触发越界写入，导致工业通信协议与控制系统失稳。

items.reason_en: SQL injection flaws in Delta DIAEnergie energy management software allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands, threatening critical power grid operations.
items.reason_zh: Delta DIAEnergie能源管理软件中的SQL注入漏洞允许远程攻击者执行任意命令，威胁关键电网的运行安全。

items.reason_en: Uncontrolled configuration file search paths in Johnson Controls AC2000 enable attackers to manipulate building automation settings and escalate privileges.
items.reason_zh: Johnson Controls AC2000中不受控制的配置文件搜索路径使攻击者能够操纵楼宇自动化设置并提升权限。

items.reason_en: SQL injection flaws in Delta DIAEnergie software permit remote code execution, directly endangering critical energy distribution and industrial automation systems.
items.reason_zh: Delta DIAEnergie软件中的SQL注入漏洞允许远程代码执行，直接危及关键电力分配与工业自动化系统。

items.reason_en: This related vulnerability further confirms systemic input validation failures in Delta's control interfaces, increasing the likelihood of successful exploitation against OT environments.
items.reason_zh: 该相关漏洞进一步证实了Delta控制接口存在系统性输入验证缺陷，增加了针对OT环境成功利用的风险。

items.reason_en: The third confirmed SQL injection instance highlights a widespread architectural weakness in Delta's ICS platform that could lead to complete system takeover by threat actors.
items.reason_zh: 第三起确认的SQL注入实例凸显了Delta ICS平台中广泛的架构弱点，可能导致威胁行为者完全接管系统。

items.reason_en: Improper access restrictions in Sick AG AppEngine Fileaccess expose sensitive filesystem areas to unauthenticated read/write operations via HTTP, jeopardizing industrial controller integrity.
items.reason_zh: Sick AG AppEngine Fileaccess中不适当的访问限制通过HTTP将敏感文件系统区域暴露给未认证的读写操作，危及工业控制器的完整性。

items.reason_en: Baylan Smart Meter Management Application completely lacks authentication for critical administrative functions, enabling unauthenticated attackers to bypass security controls and manipulate utility infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Baylan Smart Meter Management Application对关键管理功能完全缺乏身份验证，使未认证攻击者能够绕过安全控制并操纵公用事业基础设施。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited path traversal in Adobe ColdFusion allows arbitrary code execution without user interaction, representing an immediate real-world attack vector.
items.reason_zh: Adobe ColdFusion中正在被积极利用的路径遍历漏洞允许无需用户交互即可执行任意代码，构成即时的现实攻击向量。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated PHP object injection in The Events Calendar WordPress plugin enables remote code execution, affecting millions of vulnerable CMS deployments.
items.reason_zh: WordPress插件The Events Calendar中存在未认证的PHP对象注入漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，影响数百万个易受攻击的CMS部署。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in CakePHP CookieAuthenticator allows unauthorized access and potential resource exhaustion, undermining web application security frameworks.
items.reason_zh: CakePHP CookieAuthenticator中的认证绕过漏洞允许未授权访问及潜在的资源耗尽，破坏了Web应用程序的安全框架。

items.reason_en: This critical browser engine flaw allows unauthenticated remote code execution through type confusion, making it highly attractive for drive-by attacks.
items.reason_zh: 该关键浏览器引擎缺陷可通过类型混淆实现未认证的远程代码执行，使其成为旁路下载攻击的高价值目标。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in the Chromium-based browser enables remote code execution when processing malicious web content or attachments.
items.reason_zh: 基于Chromium的浏览器在处理恶意网页内容或附件时存在不安全的反序列化漏洞，可导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited in the wild, this critical SharePoint flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass authentication mechanisms and gain unauthorized network access.
items.reason_zh: 该关键SharePoint漏洞在实际环境中正遭积极利用，允许未认证攻击者绕过身份验证机制并获取未授权的网络访问权限。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypasses in the browser engine allow attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network by exploiting flawed permission checks.
items.reason_zh: 浏览器引擎中的授权绕过漏洞允许攻击者利用权限验证缺陷，通过网络执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.8; Improper file resource restrictions in GitHub Copilot allow local code execution, creating supply chain and development environment risks for AI-assisted coding tools.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 7.8；GitHub Copilot 中文件资源限制不当可导致本地代码执行，为 AI 辅助编码工具带来供应链和开发环境风险。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.8; Code injection flaws in .NET Framework enable local privilege escalation, undermining runtime security controls for web applications deployed on Windows servers.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 7.8；.NET Framework 中的代码注入缺陷可导致本地权限提升，破坏部署在 Windows 服务器上的 Web 应用程序的运行时安全控制。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5; Unrestricted resource allocation in .NET Framework causes network-based denial of service, threatening web application availability under sustained traffic or malicious requests.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 7.5；.NET Framework 中资源分配不受限会导致基于网络的拒绝服务攻击，在持续流量或恶意请求下威胁 Web 应用程序的可用性。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Active Directory Federation Services enables remote denial-of-service attacks against enterprise identity providers.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Federation Services 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可针对企业身份提供商发起远程拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Similar AD FS vulnerability allows unauthorized network-based service disruption, severely impacting single sign-on and web authentication workflows.
items.reason_zh: 类似的 AD FS 漏洞允许未经授权的基于网络的服务中断，严重影响单点登录和 Web 认证工作流。

items.reason_en: Race condition in Windows Runtime affects modern web browser contexts and application runtimes, potentially leading to local privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: Windows 运行时中的竞争条件影响现代 Web 浏览器上下文和应用程序运行时，可能导致本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft SharePoint allows remote code execution; actively exploited and directly targets enterprise web collaboration platforms.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft SharePoint 中反序列化不受信任的数据可导致远程代码执行；该漏洞正被活跃利用，直接针对企业 Web 协作平台。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Exchange Server enables network-based spoofing; high-severity flaw impacting email and web application delivery.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中的跨站脚本漏洞可实现基于网络的欺骗；此高危漏洞影响电子邮件和 Web 应用程序的交付。

items.reason_en: Unthrottled resource allocation in ASP.NET Core causes denial of service; affects backend web services processing HTTP/2 requests.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中缺乏节流的资源分配会导致拒绝服务；影响处理 HTTP/2 请求的后端 Web 服务。

items.reason_en: Critical vulnerability in Oracle WebLogic Server Proxy Plug-in is actively exploited in the wild, allowing unauthenticated remote code execution on widely deployed web servers.
items.reason_zh: Oracle WebLogic Server Proxy Plug-in 中的严重漏洞在实际环境中正被活跃利用，允许在未认证的情况下对广泛部署的 Web 服务器执行远程代码。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in ASP.NET Core using assumed-immutable data enables remote privilege escalation across modern web applications.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中利用假定为不可变的数据实现认证绕过，可在现代 Web 应用程序中导致远程权限提升。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in CakePHP via the jsonPath parameter allows attackers to extract or manipulate sensitive database contents.
items.reason_zh: CakePHP 中通过 jsonPath 参数存在的 SQL 注入漏洞允许攻击者提取或篡改敏感数据库内容。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated deletion of the .readonly file in Combodo iTop disables write protections, leading to immediate arbitrary code execution.
items.reason_zh: Combodo iTop 中未认证删除 .readonly 文件会禁用写入保护，从而导致任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated SQL injection in the Fabrikar Joomla extension allows attackers to extract or modify entire database contents by manipulating list filter parameters.
items.reason_zh: Fabrikar Joomla 扩展中存在未认证的 SQL 注入漏洞，攻击者可通过操纵列表过滤参数提取或修改整个数据库内容。

items.reason_en: Cookie value manipulation in the miniOrange OAuth Client extension enables arbitrary account takeover, including full administrative privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: miniOrange OAuth Client 扩展中的 Cookie 值操纵漏洞可导致任意账户接管，包括完全的管理员权限提升。

items.reason_en: Advanced HTML sanitization bypasses in justhtml allow dangerous script execution to survive filtering, creating persistent cross-site scripting vectors in web applications.
items.reason_zh: justhtml 中的高级 HTML 净化绕过漏洞使危险脚本能够绕过过滤并执行，从而在 Web 应用中创建持久型跨站脚本攻击面。

items.reason_en: A duplicate route configuration in rConfig bypasses authentication, allowing unauthenticated attackers to self-register as administrators and fully compromise network management platforms.
items.reason_zh: rConfig 中的重复路由配置漏洞可绕过认证，允许未认证的攻击者自注册为管理员，从而彻底攻陷网络管理平台。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables unauthenticated remote code execution, exploiting a classic and highly effective attack vector in enterprise web portals.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中反序列化不受信任的数据可导致未认证的远程代码执行，利用了企业 Web 门户中经典且高效的攻击向量。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows attackers to perform network-wide spoofing and steal sensitive user credentials or session tokens.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中的跨站脚本漏洞允许攻击者实施全网范围的欺骗，并窃取敏感的用户凭据或会话令牌。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery (SSRF) in SharePoint allows authenticated attackers to pivot internally and elevate privileges across web applications.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的服务端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞允许已认证的攻击者在内部进行横向移动，并跨 Web 应用程序提升权限。

items.reason_en: Insecure deserialization in SharePoint enables remote code execution over a network, representing a high-severity vector for web application compromise.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的不安全反序列化漏洞允许通过网络执行远程代码，是 Web 应用程序被攻陷的高危攻击向量。

items.reason_en: Code injection in Visual Studio Code allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code over a network, directly impacting developer toolchains and CI/CD pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的代码注入漏洞允许远程攻击者通过网络执行任意代码，直接影响开发者工具链和 CI/CD 流水线。

items.reason_en: Exchange Server heap overflow enables remote code execution over the network, critically impacting enterprise email infrastructure and communication channels.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 堆溢出漏洞允许通过网络执行远程代码，严重影响企业电子邮件基础设施和通信渠道。

items.reason_en: Unchecked loop conditions in .NET allow denial-of-service attacks over the network, threatening web application availability and performance.
items.reason_zh: .NET 中未检查的循环条件允许通过网络发起拒绝服务攻击，威胁 Web 应用程序的可用性和性能。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Exchange Server facilitates phishing and spoofing attacks over the network, compromising web mail client security.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中的跨站脚本漏洞助长了网络钓鱼和欺骗攻击，破坏了 Web 邮件客户端的安全性。

items.reason_en: Deserialization flaws in Microsoft Dynamics 365 enable remote code execution over the network, posing significant risks to enterprise SaaS environments.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Dynamics 365 中的反序列化缺陷允许通过网络执行远程代码，对企业 SaaS 环境构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Dynamics 365 Customer Voice enables unauthorized spoofing over the network, compromising web application security and user trust.
items.reason_zh: Dynamics 365 Customer Voice 中的跨站脚本漏洞可实现未经授权的基于网络欺骗，破坏 Web 应用安全性及用户信任。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Edge (Chromium) allows unauthorized remote code execution, frequently exploited for drive-by browser attacks.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge (Chromium) 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未授权的远程代码执行，常被用于旁路浏览器攻击。

items.reason_en: Authenticated remote code execution in Craft CMS control panel stems from a JSON cleanse bypass, directly endangering web content management deployments.
items.reason_zh: Craft CMS 控制面板中的已认证远程代码执行漏洞源于 JSON 清理绕过，直接危及 Web 内容管理系统的部署。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.3 Microsoft Edge Chromium-based use-after-free allows remote code execution over the network, targeting a widely deployed modern browser engine.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.3；Microsoft Edge Chromium内核的释放后使用漏洞允许通过网络实现远程代码执行，针对广泛部署的现代浏览器引擎。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 Microsoft Exchange Server cross-site scripting facilitates network spoofing, compromising enterprise email delivery and user authentication flows.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.1；Microsoft Exchange Server 跨站脚本漏洞可辅助网络欺骗，破坏企业邮件投递与用户认证流程。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.0 SharePoint improper authorization enables remote code execution, jeopardizing web-based collaboration platforms and shared content repositories.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.0；SharePoint 授权不当漏洞可导致远程代码执行，危及基于Web的协作平台及共享内容存储库。

items.reason_en: Authorization weakness in RansomLook's admin configuration endpoint allows authenticated non-admin users to modify critical application settings, enabling full platform takeover.
items.reason_zh: RansomLook 的管理配置端点存在授权缺陷，允许已认证的非管理员用户修改关键应用程序设置，从而导致整个平台被接管。

items.reason_en: Stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in RansomLook's cryptocurrency wallet view executes malicious scripts via unsanitized external blockchain data feeds.
items.reason_zh: RansomLook 的加密货币钱包视图存在存储型跨站脚本漏洞，可通过未过滤的外部区块链数据源执行恶意脚本。

items.reason_en: SQL injection flaw in SourceCodester Online Food Ordering System allows remote attackers to manipulate database queries and extract sensitive user or transaction data.
items.reason_zh: SourceCodester Online Food Ordering System 存在SQL注入缺陷，允许远程攻击者操纵数据库查询并提取敏感的用户或交易数据。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated remote code execution via image element handling in the Fabrik Joomla extension allows complete website takeover and backend compromise.
items.reason_zh: Fabrik Joomla 扩展在处理图像元素时存在未认证远程代码执行漏洞，可导致网站完全被接管及后端沦陷。

items.reason_en: PHP object injection through deserialization of untrusted form metadata enables unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable WordPress installations.
items.reason_zh: 通过反序列化不受信任的表单元数据导致PHP对象注入，使未认证攻击者能够在易受攻击的WordPress环境中执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Default sanitize-html configuration bypasses HTML filtering via xmp elements, facilitating stored cross-site scripting attacks on content management platforms.
items.reason_zh: sanitize-html 的默认配置可通过 xmp 元素绕过HTML过滤，从而在内容管理平台中促成存储型跨站脚本攻击。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated SQL injection in the Woo Essential WooCommerce plugin allows attackers to extract sensitive database information without valid credentials.
items.reason_zh: Woo Essential WooCommerce 插件存在未认证SQL注入漏洞，攻击者可在无有效凭据的情况下提取敏感数据库信息。

items.reason_en: User-controlled options in jsPDF allow arbitrary HTML/script injection into the browser context upon PDF generation. This creates direct cross-site scripting vectors for frontend applications.
items.reason_zh: jsPDF 中的用户可控选项允许在生成PDF时将任意HTML/脚本注入浏览器上下文。这为前端应用直接创建了跨站脚本攻击向量。

items.reason_en: JWK header injection in Authlib enables unauthenticated forgery of JWT tokens that bypass signature verification. This completely undermines OAuth 2.0 and OIDC authentication flows.
items.reason_zh: Authlib 中存在JWK头部注入漏洞，可实现无需认证的JWT令牌伪造并绕过签名验证。这彻底破坏了OAuth 2.0和OIDC认证流程。

items.reason_en: A missing cryptographic step in the DSA signing implementation allows attackers to force invalid signatures and recover private keys. This severely compromises asymmetric cryptography in JavaScript environments.
items.reason_zh: DSA签名实现中缺失加密步骤，允许攻击者强制生成无效签名并恢复私钥。这严重破坏了JavaScript环境中的非对称加密安全性。

items.reason_en: jsrsasign fails to properly validate DSA domain parameters, allowing attackers to forge cryptographic signatures and X.509 certificates, breaking trust in web authentication flows.
items.reason_zh: jsrsasign 未能正确验证DSA域参数，允许攻击者伪造加密签名和X.509证书，破坏Web认证流程的信任机制。

items.reason_en: Postiz social media scheduling tool exposes locally stored media via unauthenticated routes that concatenate URL paths without sanitization, enabling severe path traversal and arbitrary file reads.
items.reason_zh: Postiz 社交媒体排程工具通过未认证的路由暴露本地存储的媒体文件，这些路由在未过滤的情况下拼接URL路径，导致严重的目录遍历和任意文件读取漏洞。

items.reason_en: Axios prototype pollution gadgets can be escalated into full Man-in-the-Middle attacks, allowing attackers to intercept and modify HTTPS traffic in Node.js applications.
items.reason_zh: Axios 的原型污染利用链可升级为完整的中间人攻击，使攻击者能够拦截并篡改Node.js应用中的HTTPS流量。

items.reason_en: Ruby ERB templating engine contains a deserialization bypass when reconstructing objects via Marshal.load, enabling remote code execution through crafted serialized payloads.
items.reason_zh: Ruby ERB 模板引擎在使用 Marshal.load 重建对象时存在反序列化绕过漏洞，可通过构造的序列化载荷实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Joomla Page Builder CK extension contains a SQL injection vulnerability in its styles model, allowing attackers to extract database contents or manipulate application data.
items.reason_zh: Joomla Page Builder CK 扩展在其样式模型中存在SQL注入漏洞，允许攻击者提取数据库内容或篡改应用程序数据。

items.reason_en: Grav CMS API plugin fails to enforce API key scope caps on scheduler configuration endpoints, allowing scoped keys to execute privileged administrative actions.
items.reason_zh: Grav CMS API 插件未在调度器配置端点上强制执行API密钥作用域限制，导致受限密钥仍可执行特权管理操作。

items.reason_en: Guardian language-system passes unsanitized GET parameters directly into SQL queries across multiple PHP endpoints, enabling authenticated attackers to perform error-based SQL injection.
items.reason_zh: Guardian language-system 在多个PHP端点中将未过滤的GET参数直接传入SQL查询，使已认证攻击者能够实施报错型SQL注入。

items.reason_en: PyJWT does not validate JSON Web Keys when decoding tokens with mixed asymmetric/HMAC algorithms, allowing attackers to forge tokens using the issuer's public key as the HMAC secret.
items.reason_zh: PyJWT 在解码混合非对称/HMAC算法令牌时未验证JSON Web Key，攻击者可利用发行者的公钥作为HMAC密钥来伪造令牌。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SQL Server permits remote code execution over the network, directly endangering enterprise database servers.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 对不受信任数据进行反序列化操作允许通过网络实现远程代码执行，直接威胁企业数据库服务器安全。

items.reason_en: Identical critical deserialization flaw in SQL Server highlights systemic middleware risks that require immediate patching to prevent automated exploitation.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中相同的严重反序列化缺陷凸显了系统性中间件风险，需立即修补以防止自动化利用。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8; SQL injection in SQL Server allows network-based privilege escalation, threatening database integrity and enabling full system compromise if left unpatched.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8；SQL Server 中的SQL注入漏洞允许基于网络的权限提升，威胁数据库完整性，若未及时修补将导致系统完全沦陷。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.8; Deserialization of untrusted data in .NET facilitates local code execution, representing a critical risk for backend services and application servers relying on this framework.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 7.8；.NET 中对不受信任数据进行反序列化可促成本地代码执行，对依赖该框架的后端服务与应用服务器构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5; An infinite loop in Active Directory Federation Services triggers network-based denial of service, disrupting critical authentication and single sign-on operations.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 7.5；Active Directory Federation Services 中的无限循环会触发基于网络的拒绝服务攻击，中断关键的身份验证与单点登录操作。

items.reason_en: External control of file path in SQL Server allows privilege escalation; directly threatens database server integrity and execution boundaries.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中存在外部控制文件路径漏洞，可导致权限提升；直接威胁数据库服务器完整性及执行边界。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Exchange Server enables remote code execution; impacts mail transport agents and messaging middleware.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致远程代码执行；影响邮件传输代理及消息中间件。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the SQL Server ODBC driver enables unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, threatening database connectivity layers.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server ODBC 驱动程序中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许通过网络实现未认证的远程代码执行，威胁数据库连接层安全。

items.reason_en: Easily exploitable infrastructure vulnerability in Oracle Essbase allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve complete system takeover via HTTP.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Essbase 中存在易于利用的基础设施漏洞，允许未认证攻击者通过HTTP实现系统完全接管。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Oracle Hyperion Financial Management permits low-privileged users to compromise financial data and application logic.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Hyperion Financial Management 中的 SQL 注入漏洞允许低权限用户破坏财务数据和应用程序逻辑。

items.reason_en: Arc Enterprise's Raft consensus module accepts attacker-controlled file paths during manifest registration, risking storage backend corruption and data loss.
items.reason_zh: Arc Enterprise 的 Raft 共识模块在清单注册期间接受攻击者控制的文件路径，可能导致存储后端损坏和数据丢失。

items.reason_en: TypeORM's lack of validation on distinct query arrays enables direct SQL injection against PostgreSQL databases when generating complex statements.
items.reason_zh: TypeORM 对 distinct 查询数组缺乏验证，在生成复杂语句时可直接针对 PostgreSQL 数据库实施 SQL 注入。

items.reason_en: Weak cryptographic primitives in HCL Hive increase the risk of credential leakage and unauthorized lateral movement across distributed middleware environments.
items.reason_zh: HCL Hive 中弱加密原语增加了凭据泄露和跨分布式中间件环境未经授权横向移动的风险。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in the Priority ERP Portal Generator addon grants full unauthorized access to enterprise resource planning modules, risking severe data breaches.
items.reason_zh: Priority ERP Portal Generator 插件中的身份验证缺陷授予了对企业资源规划模块的完全未授权访问权限，可能导致严重的数据泄露。

items.reason_en: An easily exploitable vulnerability in Oracle E-Business Suite Call Center Technology allows low-privileged network attackers to compromise critical enterprise middleware components.
items.reason_zh: Oracle E-Business Suite Call Center Technology 中存在易于利用的漏洞，允许低权限网络攻击者破坏关键的企业中间件组件。

items.reason_en: Security flaws in Oracle Hyperion Financial Management permit unauthenticated network compromise, threatening the confidentiality and integrity of sensitive financial reporting data.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Hyperion Financial Management 中的安全缺陷允许未经身份验证的网络入侵，威胁敏感财务报告数据的机密性和完整性。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in the .NET Framework allows remote privilege escalation over a network, affecting a broad spectrum of backend services and middleware deployments.
items.reason_zh: .NET Framework 中的授权错误允许通过网络进行远程权限提升，影响广泛的后台服务和中间件部署。

items.reason_en: LDAP heap overflow allows remote code execution over the network, directly compromising directory services and authentication middleware.
items.reason_zh: LDAP 堆溢出漏洞允许通过网络执行远程代码，直接破坏目录服务和身份验证中间件。

items.reason_en: LDAP use-after-free vulnerability enables network-based remote code execution, threatening core identity and access management systems.
items.reason_zh: LDAP 释放后使用（use-after-free）漏洞可实现基于网络的远程代码执行，威胁核心身份与访问管理系统。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in the .NET Framework permits local code execution, affecting the underlying runtime environment for numerous enterprise applications.
items.reason_zh: .NET Framework 中的整数溢出漏洞允许本地代码执行，影响众多企业应用程序的底层运行时环境。

items.reason_en: Uncaught exception handling in .NET allows local privilege escalation, weakening the security posture of the application runtime framework.
items.reason_zh: .NET 中未捕获异常处理不当允许本地权限提升，削弱了应用程序运行时框架的安全态势。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Azure SQL Database permits authorized attackers to elevate privileges, risking data exfiltration and database integrity.
items.reason_zh: Azure SQL Database 中的 SQL 注入漏洞允许已认证的攻击者提升权限，可能导致数据外泄和数据库完整性受损。

items.reason_en: Easily exploitable vulnerability in Oracle E-Business Suite Internal Operations allows network-based compromise, affecting enterprise ERP middleware operations.
items.reason_zh: Oracle E-Business Suite Internal Operations 中存在易于利用的漏洞，允许基于网络的入侵，影响企业 ERP 中间件操作。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 Oracle Application Testing Suite vulnerability allows low-privileged attackers to compromise the middleware via HTTPS, disrupting automated testing pipelines.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 评分为 8.8 的 Oracle Application Testing Suite 漏洞允许低权限攻击者通过 HTTPS 破坏中间件，导致自动化测试流水线中断。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 Dynamics 365 on-premises improper permission handling enables network privilege escalation, impacting enterprise ERP and business logic layers.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 评分为 8.8 的 Dynamics 365 本地部署版本存在权限处理不当问题，可导致网络权限提升，影响企业 ERP 和业务逻辑层。

items.reason_en: Easily exploitable unauthenticated vulnerability in Oracle Hyperion DRM allows complete system compromise over TCP, threatening enterprise financial planning middleware.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Hyperion DRM 中存在易于利用的未认证漏洞，允许通过 TCP 实现系统完全沦陷，威胁企业财务规划中间件。

items.reason_en: Arbitrary systemd property injection via Pod annotations in Red Hat cri-o enables container escape and host-level command execution, undermining Kubernetes orchestration.
items.reason_zh: 通过 Red Hat cri-o 中的 Pod 注解可注入任意 systemd 属性，从而实现容器逃逸和主机级命令执行，破坏 Kubernetes 编排能力。

items.reason_en: Secret key exposure in Grafana Pyroscope when configured with Tencent COS storage allows attackers to extract cloud credentials and compromise profiling data backends.
items.reason_zh: 当 Grafana Pyroscope 配置为使用腾讯云 COS 存储时，密钥泄露漏洞允许攻击者提取云凭据并破坏分析数据后端。

items.reason_en: Privilege escalation in the StackGres Kubernetes operator allows low-privilege database tenants to gain administrator access, compromising managed cluster security.
items.reason_zh: StackGres Kubernetes 控制器中的权限提升漏洞允许低权限数据库租户获取管理员访问权限，危及托管集群的安全性。

items.reason_en: Missing explicit search base configuration in SSSD's LDAP sudo provider allows authenticated attackers to inject sudoRole objects granting root-level privileges across directories.
items.reason_zh: SSSD 的 LDAP sudo 提供程序缺少显式搜索基配置，允许已认证的攻击者注入授予跨目录根级别权限的 sudoRole 对象。

items.reason_en: HTTP/1.1 parser vulnerability to request smuggling via chunk extensions can bypass security controls in web application proxies and reverse proxy setups.
items.reason_zh: HTTP/1.1 解析器对通过分块扩展进行的请求走私存在漏洞，可能绕过 Web 应用代理和反向代理设置中的安全控制措施。

items.reason_en: Incorrect wrapping of user-supplied TrustManagers may bypass custom certificate validation logic, weakening TLS security in Java-based network applications.
items.reason_zh: 对用户提供的 TrustManagers 进行不正确的包装可能绕过自定义证书验证逻辑，削弱基于 Java 的网络应用程序的 TLS 安全性。

items.reason_en: Integer narrowing and overflow-prone arithmetic in the Avro decoder lead to out-of-bounds reads on 32-bit targets. This destabilizes data serialization pipelines relying on Apache Avro.
items.reason_zh: Avro 解码器中的整数收窄和易溢出的算术运算会导致 32 位目标上发生越界读取。这会破坏依赖 Apache Avro 的数据序列化流水线的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Excessively large iteration counts in SCRAM authentication handling freeze the Kafka client event loop. This enables denial-of-service attacks against message queue consumers.
items.reason_zh: SCRAM 身份验证处理中过大的迭代次数会冻结 Kafka 客户端事件循环。这使得针对消息队列消费者的拒绝服务攻击成为可能。

items.reason_en: A hardcoded MurmurHash3 seed in jq allows offline precomputation of JSON key collisions. Attackers can trigger algorithmic complexity DoS against JSON processing middleware.
items.reason_zh: jq 中硬编码的 MurmurHash3 种子允许离线预计算 JSON 键冲突。攻击者可针对 JSON 处理中间件触发算法复杂度拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: JBoss Marshalling River unmarshaller processes Infinispan session replication data without class filtering, enabling unauthenticated remote code execution via standard deserialization gadget chains.
items.reason_zh: JBoss Marshalling River 解组器在处理 Infinispan 会话复制数据时未进行类过滤，可通过标准反序列化利用链实现未经身份验证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: libxml2 triggers a use-after-free condition when parsing specific XPath elements within XML schematron schemas, allowing attackers to craft malicious documents that lead to memory corruption and potential RCE.
items.reason_zh: libxml2 在解析 XML schematron 模式中的特定 XPath 元素时会触发释放后使用条件，允许攻击者构造恶意文档，导致内存损坏及潜在的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Processing certain sch:name elements in libxml2 input files triggers memory corruption, enabling attackers to crash the parser or achieve undefined behavior through crafted XML inputs.
items.reason_zh: 处理 libxml2 输入文件中的某些 sch:name 元素会触发内存损坏，使攻击者能够通过构造的 XML 输入导致解析器崩溃或产生未定义行为。

items.reason_en: ArcadeDB trigger executor incorrectly whitelists java.lang.* packages, allowing authenticated schema users to execute arbitrary JavaScript that invokes Runtime.exec for remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: ArcadeDB 触发器执行器错误地将 java.lang.* 包列入白名单，允许已认证的架构用户执行调用 Runtime.exec 的任意 JavaScript 代码以实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: EAP's IIOP NameService accepts unauthenticated bind operations, enabling attackers to hijack JNDI lookups and redirect them to malicious ORBs for man-in-the-middle or denial-of-service attacks.
items.reason_zh: EAP的IIOP NameService接受未认证绑定操作，使攻击者能够劫持JNDI查找并将其重定向至恶意ORB，从而实施中间人或拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Crafted HTJ2K-compressed EXR files cause unconditional process abort in OpenEXR, disrupting motion picture industry rendering and compositing workflows.
items.reason_zh: 精心构造的HTJ2K压缩EXR文件会导致OpenEXR无条件中止进程，破坏影视行业的渲染与合成工作流。

items.reason_en: Memory leak via repeated abort listener registration in libp2p allows remote peers to trigger resource exhaustion, impacting decentralized networking stacks.
items.reason_zh: libp2p中通过重复注册中止监听器导致内存泄漏，允许远程对等节点触发资源耗尽，影响去中心化网络栈。

items.reason_en: Protection mechanism failure in Visual Studio allows unauthorized local code execution, compromising developer environments and build pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio的保护机制失效可导致未授权的本地代码执行，危及开发环境与构建流水线。

items.reason_en: This ERP platform flaw permits unauthenticated remote code execution via unsafe deserialization, threatening critical business operations.
items.reason_zh: 该ERP平台漏洞允许通过不安全的反序列化实现未认证的远程代码执行，威胁关键业务运营。

items.reason_en: Cross-sphere functionality inclusion in VS Code allows attackers to bypass security controls remotely, compromising developer toolchains.
items.reason_zh: VS Code中跨作用域的功能引入允许攻击者远程绕过安全控制，危及开发者工具链。

items.reason_en: Commonly targeted via phishing, this Word heap overflow enables local code execution through malicious document parsing.
items.reason_zh: 该Word堆溢出漏洞常通过钓鱼邮件传播，可通过解析恶意文档实现本地代码执行。

items.reason_en: Type confusion in the .NET runtime can trigger remote denial of service, disrupting application availability and backend services.
items.reason_zh: .NET运行时中的类型混淆可触发远程拒绝服务，破坏应用可用性与后端服务。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8; Heap-based buffer overflow in Minecraft Bedrock Dedicated Server permits network code execution, affecting game server operators and potentially serving as an initial access vector.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 9.8；Minecraft Bedrock Dedicated Server中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出允许通过网络执行代码，影响游戏服务器运营商，并可能作为初始访问向量。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.0; Time-of-check time-of-use race condition in Microsoft Defender allows local privilege escalation, potentially bypassing endpoint protection mechanisms during security enforcement.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 7.0；Microsoft Defender中的检查时-使用时（TOCTOU）竞争条件可导致本地权限提升，可能在安全策略执行期间绕过端点保护机制。

items.reason_en: Race condition in Windows USB Driver allows local privilege escalation, posing a threat for physical access attacks and peripheral security.
items.reason_zh: Windows USB驱动程序中的竞争条件可导致本地权限提升，对物理接触攻击及外设安全构成威胁。

items.reason_en: Improper link resolution in RRAS allows local privilege escalation, affecting routing and remote access server configurations.
items.reason_zh: RRAS中的链接解析不当可导致本地权限提升，影响路由和远程访问服务器配置。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows Kernel-Mode Drivers presents a persistent local escalation risk across various hardware abstraction layers.
items.reason_zh: Windows内核模式驱动程序中的释放后使用漏洞在多种硬件抽象层中持续存在本地权限提升风险。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Visual Studio Code allows local code execution; affects developer toolchains and integrated development environments.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code中的命令注入漏洞允许本地代码执行；影响开发者工具链及集成开发环境。

items.reason_en: Relative path traversal in Age of Empires II allows remote code execution; highlights security gaps in network-exposed gaming servers.
items.reason_zh: 《帝国时代II》中的相对路径遍历漏洞允许远程代码执行；凸显了面向网络的遊戲服务器存在的安全缺陷。

items.reason_en: Xinference passes untrusted LLM tool-call outputs directly to Python's eval() function, enabling straightforward remote code execution in AI inference deployments.
items.reason_zh: Xinference将不受信任的大语言模型工具调用输出直接传递给Python的eval()函数，使得AI推理部署中极易发生远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Prototype pollution in JSONata occurs due to a missing hasOwnProperty check, allowing crafted expressions to modify global object states and disrupt applications.
items.reason_zh: JSONata中的原型链污染漏洞源于缺少hasOwnProperty检查，允许构造的表达式修改全局对象状态并破坏应用程序。

items.reason_en: Malicious VNC servers can trigger an out-of-bounds heap write in LibVNCClient, corrupting client memory and potentially executing arbitrary code.
items.reason_zh: 恶意VNC服务器可在LibVNCClient中触发越界堆写入，破坏客户端内存并可能执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Loading untrusted machine learning models via FlairNLP triggers arbitrary Python execution through unsafe pickle deserialization, posing severe supply chain risks.
items.reason_zh: 通过FlairNLP加载不受信任的机器学习模型会通过不安全的pickle反序列化触发任意Python代码执行，带来严重的供应链安全风险。

items.reason_en: Unescaped special characters in exceljs-hardened CSV exports enable formula injection attacks that execute malicious macros when opened in spreadsheet software.
items.reason_zh: exceljs-hardened导出的CSV文件中未转义的特殊字符可引发公式注入攻击，在电子表格软件中打开时将执行恶意宏。

items.reason_en: Inconsistent URI canonicalization in fast-uri breaks security boundary checks for scheme-relative references, potentially allowing unintended resource access.
items.reason_zh: fast-uri中URI规范化不一致会破坏针对协议相对引用的安全边界检查，可能导致非预期的资源访问。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows Win32K graphics subsystem enables local privilege escalation, frequently targeted in drive-by download attacks.
items.reason_zh: Windows Win32K图形子系统中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可导致本地权限提升，常被用于驱动下载攻击。

items.reason_en: Improper link resolution in the Accessibility Infrastructure (ATBroker.exe) allows local privilege escalation by exploiting accessibility features enabled by default.
items.reason_zh: 辅助功能基础设施（ATBroker.exe）中的链接解析不当可通过利用默认启用的辅助功能实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Visual Studio Code enables unauthorized remote code execution, exposing developer workstations and CI/CD environments to compromise.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code中缺失授权验证可导致未授权的远程代码执行，使开发工作站及CI/CD环境面临被入侵风险。

items.reason_en: Inclusion of functionality from an untrusted control sphere in Visual Studio Code allows local privilege escalation, highlighting extension ecosystem risks.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code中引入不受信任控制域的功能可导致本地权限提升，凸显扩展生态系统的风险。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 Nuance PowerScribe deserialization vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote code execution, posing severe operational risks to medical dictation systems.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 9.8；Nuance PowerScribe的反序列化漏洞允许未认证的远程代码执行，对医疗语音录入系统构成严重运营风险。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.7 RansomLook privacy bypass exposes sensitive ransomware victim data to external notification channels, complicating threat intelligence and incident response efforts.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.7；RansomLook的隐私绕过漏洞会将勒索软件受害者的敏感数据暴露给外部通知渠道，增加威胁情报收集与事件响应的难度。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in GitLab's package registry allows authenticated users to achieve remote code execution under specific deployment conditions, threatening DevSecOps pipelines.
items.reason_zh: GitLab包注册中心的路径遍历漏洞允许认证用户在特定部署条件下实现远程代码执行，威胁DevSecOps流水线。

items.reason_en: Loads Hugging Face models with trust_remote_code enabled unconditionally, exposing AI inference servers to remote code execution via malicious model loaders.
items.reason_zh: 无条件启用trust_remote_code加载Hugging Face模型，使AI推理服务器面临通过恶意模型加载器执行远程代码的风险。

items.reason_en: Flaw in Velociraptor's VQL verify function allows permission-less overwriting of global artifacts, undermining endpoint detection and response integrity.
items.reason_zh: Velociraptor的VQL验证函数存在缺陷，允许无需权限覆盖全局工件，破坏了端点检测与响应（EDR）的完整性。

items.reason_en: Fixes packet handling for paged fragments in the Linux kernel's RxRPC protocol, preventing potential data corruption or denial of service in network stacks.
items.reason_zh: 修复了Linux内核中RxRPC协议处理分页片段的逻辑，防止网络协议栈中出现潜在的数据损坏或拒绝服务问题。

items.reason_en: An out-of-bounds read occurs in the CIFS client when sanitizing SMB paths containing only delimiters. Mounting malicious shares could trigger kernel panics or information leaks.
items.reason_zh: 在清理仅包含分隔符的SMB路径时，CIFS客户端会发生越界读取。挂载恶意共享可能触发内核崩溃或导致信息泄露。

items.reason_en: Improper CPU cache isolation on AMD Zen 2 processors allows cross-privilege instruction corruption. This hardware-level flaw risks privilege escalation and system stability.
items.reason_zh: AMD Zen 2处理器上的CPU缓存隔离不当会导致跨特权级指令被篡改。该硬件级缺陷存在权限提升和破坏系统稳定性的风险。

items.reason_en: Incorrect length handling in libsolv's PGP verification component causes a stack buffer overflow. Package managers relying on EdDSA signatures are vulnerable to crashes or exploitation.
items.reason_zh: libsolv的PGP验证组件中存在长度处理错误，导致栈缓冲区溢出。依赖EdDSA签名的软件包管理器易受崩溃或利用攻击的影响。

items.reason_en: Python wheel unpacking blindly trusts filenames from archives, leading to file permission modification vulnerabilities that could be exploited to escalate privileges during package installation.
items.reason_zh: Python wheel解压过程盲目信任归档文件中的文件名，导致文件权限修改漏洞，攻击者可在包安装期间利用该漏洞进行提权。
